query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Migrate Vercel projects and GitHub repositories between connected accounts, preserve domains and settings, add deployment workflows, trigger/verify deployments, and audit repository access.
query_ground_truth.intent: Configure and add deployment workflows connecting the GitHub repository to Vercel.

requirement_groups.purpose: Add or update a deployment workflow file in the GitHub repository

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if repository identifier or default ref is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch repository metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY (confirm access; capture repository identifier and default ref for linking/deploy).
[Optional (if deploying under a non-default/shared scope)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve target scope using VERCEL_GET_TEAMS (select scope and reuse in later calls).
[Optional (if a project may already exist)] [Prerequisite]: Check for an existing project using VERCEL_GET_PROJECT2 (reuse existing settings/identifiers if found).

[Required] [Step]: Create and (when supported) link the hosting project using VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2 (provide repository path; set framework/root/build settings; optionally set environmentVariables; capture returned project identifiers/link metadata).

[Fallback (if VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2 fails when git linking is included)] [Fallback]: Retry VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2 without gitRepository (create unlinked project, then rely on Git-based deploy triggers or manual deploy creation).

[Optional (if an initial deploy is desired)] [Next Step]: Create a deployment using VERCEL_CREATE_NEW_DEPLOYMENT (use gitSource with repository identifier and ref; ensure exactly one of files, gitSource, or deploymentId is set).

[Optional (if you need to confirm or debug deployments)] [Next Step]: List recent deploys using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS (pick latest id/url) and inspect build output via VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2 (identify actionable errors before retrying).
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY] Can fail with a no-connection/no-active-connection style error if the source-control connection is not active.
[VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2] Including gitRepository may return HTTP 400 when provider integration/access is missing; retry by omitting gitRepository.
[VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2] environmentVariables values may be echoed in responses; avoid logging or persisting full responses when secrets are included.
[VERCEL_CREATE_NEW_DEPLOYMENT] Must provide exactly one of files, gitSource, or deploymentId or you can hit HTTP 400 validation errors; gitSource.sha can trigger HTTP 400 "incorrect_git_source_info".
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS] Deployments may show an error/blocked state due to commit author identity not being associated with the Git provider; resolve externally before re-deploying.

VERCEL_CREATE_PROJECT2.description: Tool to create a new Vercel project with comprehensive configuration options. Use when you need to create a project with specific settings like environment variables, framework selection, Git repository connection, resource configuration, or deployment policies.

name.description: The desired name for the project. Must be lowercase and can only contain letters, digits, '.', '_', and '-'. Cannot contain the sequence '---'. Maximum 100 characters.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

framework.description: The framework being used for this project. When null, no framework is selected

devCommand.description: The dev command for this project. When null is used, this value will be automatically detected

buildCommand.description: The build command for this project. When null is used, this value will be automatically detected

publicSource.description: Specifies whether the source code and logs of the deployments for this project should be public or not

repo.description: Name of the git repository, e.g., "vercel/next.js"

gitRepository.description: Git repository configuration for automatic deployments.

rootDirectory.description: The name of a directory or relative path to the source code. When null, it will default to the project root

deploymentType.description: Which deployments to apply SSO protection to

ssoProtection.description: SSO protection configuration for the project.

installCommand.description: The install command for this project. When null is used, this value will be automatically detected

functionDefaultRegions.description: Regions to deploy Vercel Functions to for this project

functionDefaultTimeout.description: Default timeout for functions in seconds

functionDefaultMemoryType.description: Memory type for functions. Note: 'performance' option may require a specific plan tier

functionZeroConfigFailover.description: Whether Zero Config Failover is enabled

resourceConfig.description: Resource override configuration for the project.

enabled.description: Whether to generate OpenID Connect JSON Web Tokens

outputDirectory.description: The output directory of the project. When null is used, this value will be automatically detected

type.description: Type of the environment variable. Use 'encrypted' for sensitive data like API keys, 'plain' for non-sensitive values, 'secret' for secrets from integrations, or 'sensitive' for values that should be redacted in logs

gitBranch.description: Git branch to which this environment variable applies

items.description: Environment variable configuration for a project.

environmentVariables.description: Collection of environment variables the project will use

enablePreviewFeedback.description: Opt-in to preview toolbar on the project level

previewDeploymentSuffix.description: Custom domain suffix for preview deployments. Must be a domain owned by the team

enableProductionFeedback.description: Opt-in to production toolbar on the project level

serverlessFunctionRegion.description: The region to deploy Serverless Functions in this project

commandForIgnoringBuildStep.description: Command to determine whether to skip the build step

serverlessFunctionZeroConfigFailover.description: Specifies whether Zero Config Failover is enabled for this project
